description: This Java class `FilePathUtils` provides utility methods for constructing various URL paths and file paths used within the sales manager web application. It handles storage paths for images and digital product downloads, as well as building store and URL specific links used throughout the e-commerce platform.

classes.name: FilePathUtils
classes.description: Utility class for constructing URLs and file paths related to store content, downloads, and other resource links.

methods.name: buildStaticFilePath
methods.description: Constructs a file path for static content such as images based on store code and image name.

methods.name: buildAdminDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Builds a URL path for downloading a digital product file in the admin interface.

methods.name: buildOrderDownloadProductFilePath
methods.description: Creates a URL path for customers to download a product associated with a specific order.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Generates the full store URL including scheme, domain, and context path.

methods.name: buildStoreUri
methods.description: Overloaded method to build store URL with a provided context path.

methods.name: buildCustomerUri
methods.description: Constructs the customer section URL for a store given the context path.

methods.name: buildAdminUri
methods.description: Builds the admin URL for a store, incorporating session-specific configurations.

methods.name: buildCategoryUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for a store category based on the store, context path, and category URL segment.

methods.name: buildProductUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for a store product given the store, context path, and product URL segment.
